name: ASAS Blueprint Task Register Index

source.document: ASAS Real Estate OS — Task Register

discrepancy.rule: Do not silently choose a normative count; reconcile against the authoritative source/edition before promotion.

canonicalization_requirements: Every task keeps its permanent source ID.
Task contract and acceptance evidence are preserved.
No task is implementation-ready until dependencies and applicable gates are resolved.
Counts, IDs, references, and provenance validate against the source.
Observed-vs-declared count discrepancies require explicit reconciliation.
repository_copy_policy: Do not blindly copy the package; derived shards/manifests must remain provenance-tagged and non-ambiguous.
